jobs.description:
Siemens Energy

"We energize society" - "Wir versorgen die Gesellschaft mit Energie", indem wir unsere Kunden unterstützen beim Übergang in eine nachhaltigere Welt. Basis ... 1 Project Planner (f/m/d) As a Project Planner within our Gas Services division, you will be responsible within the project team and at the project construction site for the preparation and controlling of the integrated project time schedule in accordance with the relevant process procedure for complex and high risk turnkey projects or within a consortium.

How You'll Make an Impact

 * Develop and optimize the overall project time schedule for complex turnkey or consortium projects, which typically involve around 3000 to 5000 activities, using a reference time schedule as a foundation for planning.
 * Adapt and refine the time schedule to meet specific project requirements by employing proven methods that ensure the successful completion of the project within the designated timeframe.
 * Coordinate the time schedule with the project team and consortium partners to facilitate the timely release of the Project Manager (PM), ensuring that all stakeholders are aligned and informed.
 * Present the Siemens Energy Time Management concept convincingly to customers, consortium partners, and suppliers, with the goal of applying our standards while minimizing the need for adjustments.
 * Provide support for Contract Management (CM) and Proposal Planning by integrating time management considerations into the overall project strategy and documentation.
 * Continuously monitor and follow up on the time schedule, taking into account boundary conditions and collaborating with different project managers, consortium partners, and site staff to ensure adherence to timelines.
 * Conduct regular checks to control progress and ensure that target dates are met across various disciplines, including those involving consortium partners and on-site personnel.
 * Collect and analyze relevant schedule data to evaluate the impact on project progress, including factors such as manhours, quantities, and contractual milestones, and communicate findings to the Project Manager.
 * Prepare internal reports related to the time schedule, such as MTA, S-curves, EVM, variance reports, and critical path reports, to provide insights into project performance and areas for improvement.
 * Identify and document all claim-relevant delays and corresponding events in a delay register, ensuring that this information is archived for future analysis and claim preparation, including activities related to consortium partners.

What You Bring

 * Bachelor's degree with focus project management and process management, or a related discipline.
 * Experience in the execution of turnkey and consortium projects, work at construction sites /regional unit execution
 * Advanced proficiency in Primavera software
 * Advanced understanding in regards of time management, process management and associated PM knowledge areas (interface management, document management, contract management, etc.)
 * Excellent communication skills in English and German with the ability to present complex planning data clearly to diverse stakeholders.
 * Strong analytical mindset with well developed problem solving capabilities.
 * Willingness to work on projects abroad
 * Driving license

Rewards/Benefits

 * The opportunity to engage in an exciting environment on meaningful projects
 * Opportunities for career growth within a supportive workplace culture
 * International environment, along with a pension fund
 * Enjoy flexible working hours and the option to work from home
 * Access to a canteen or meal allowances

And more!

We look forward to your application.

jobs.description:
Silicon Austria Labs (SAL) - In the network of science and industry, SAL offers research in the areas of Sensor Systems, RF Systems, Power Electronics, System Integration Technologies and Embedded Systems.
SAL - a great ... 1 Pilot Line Process Integration Lead (all genders) // Job-ID: 245-0 Deine zukünftigen Aufgaben
In the position as Staff Research Engineer you are the central technical interface across SAL's technology platforms and pilot-line activities. You ensure coherent end-to-end process flows, strong documentation and traceability, and effective coordination between R&D teams, pilot-line technical leads, and SAL MicroFab. You also support external requests by translating them into executable technical scopes.

Your responsibilities include:

 * Cross-platform process integration: maintain an end-to-end overview of process flows and module interfaces (e.g., thin films, lithography, etch, metrology closure) across integrated photonics, MEMS and related technology stacks.
 * Baseline flows & readiness: define and maintain reference flows versus development lanes; support readiness reviews and ensure clear release criteria for stable execution.
 * Process change control & documentation discipline: ensure recipe/version control, run cards, parameter windows, and structured documentation of decisions and learnings.
 * Know-how capture: support structured capture of process know-how and clarify what can be shared externally vs protected, in collaboration with responsible functions.
 * Traceability / data backbone: ensure wafer genealogy, run history, recipe versions, and measurement linkage are consistently captured to build a scalable single source of truth.
 * Coordination interface: act as the key technical coordination contact with SAL MicroFab to align run readiness, documentation requirements, execution constraints, and release criteria (without owning MicroFab operations).
 * Stability & continuous improvement: drive variability reduction and improvement loops (metrology closure, deviation handling, root-cause analysis) and feed improvements back into baseline flows and documentation.
 * External request (open access): support business development and pilot-line teams by translating external requests into executable technical scopes (capability check, feasibility, assumptions/risks, measurement package, deliverables) and matching requests to the right platform capability.

Dein Profil
 * Proven experience (min. 8+ years) in semiconductor process integration and wafer fab execution in an applied R&D / microfabrication environment.
 * MSc/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Microsystems, or comparable.
 * Strong understanding of thin-film and microfabrication process flows and interface points (module integration, variability drivers, metrology closure).
 * Demonstrated strength in documentation discipline; experience with traceability/MES workflows is a plus.
 * Structured, data-driven problem solving (variability/yield thinking, root-cause analysis; SPC/DoE basics appreciated).
 * Strong communication and coordination skills across technical teams in a matrix organization; comfortable interfacing with external partners/users.
 * Fluent English; German is a plus.

This position is subject to the Collective Agreement for employees in non-university research (Research CA) starting in occupational group F (F1 salary = EUR 4.757,- paid 14 times a year, based on 38,5 hours per week). For this position we offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your experience and qualifications, starting with a minimum gross salary of EUR 70.000 (annual, based on an All-in contract and bonus).
